identity.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][api] Define the complete versioned Runtime and Observatory OpenAPI contracts

values.summary: Bind #5701, inventory real Runtime v3 routes and schemas, add canonical OpenAPI artifacts plus route-parity validation, coordinate any #5344-protected route-serving edits, review exact head once, publish a ready PR closing #5701, and shepherd CI.

steps.action: Initialize and bind #5701 in its dedicated worktree with disjoint protected paths
Inventory real Runtime v3 and Observatory routes, schemas, security, and WSS messages
Author canonical Runtime Core and Observatory OpenAPI documents plus versioning note
Add focused route-parity, schema/reference, and client-generation-suitability validation
Integrate served discovery endpoints if #5344 protected paths are released or transferred
Run exact-head subagent review, fix findings, publish ready PR, and shepherd CI

invariants: No documented operational route may be fixture-only, receipt-only, simulated, degraded, or unavailable
HTML Observatory stays separate from Runtime v3
#5701 does not mutate #5344 worktree or protected paths without typed authority
risks: #5344 currently protects the router/config files needed for serving discovery endpoints
The real route inventory may be smaller than issue text expectations because unsupported adapters must not be claimed
OpenAPI cannot fully model bidirectional WSS without vendor extensions
stop_conditions: Any typed claim collision with #5344 or another active issue
Any need to edit protected #5344 router/config/bin paths without typed transfer/release
